title: oreoseris gossypina
intro: Oreoseris gossypina, commonly known as Gossypina or Gossypine, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Oreoseris gossypina are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory issues, among other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Oreoseris gossypina include flavonoids, terpenoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
